entries.Nux indie: Nux indie. Complexio: calida in 2º humida in 1º. Electio: recens dulcis. Iuuamentum: confert strangurie et acuit intellectum. Nocumentum: tarde descendit de stomacho. Remotio nocumenti: cum penidiis cucariis. Quid generat: multum sanguinem acutum. Conuenit frigidis et siccis in autumpno senibus regione meridionali.
entries.Nuces: Nuces. Complexio: calida in primo, humida in 2º. Electio: que uelociter enucleantur. Iuuamentum: stupori dentium ac ueneno. Nocumentum: generant botor in ore, gutture et lingua. Remotio nocumenti: cum semine papaueris albi et amigdalis dulcibus. Quid generant: sanguinem calidum. Conueniunt frigidis, decrepitis, hyeme et montanis regionibus.
entries.Castanee: Castanee. Complexio: calida in primo, seca en 2º. Electio: complete et bene mature. Iuuamentum: pectori difficultati urine, confortant appetitum et remouent mauseam et uomitum. Nocumentum: inferunt cerebro et stomacho earum uentositate. Remotio nocumenti: si assentur et comedantur cum sale et bono uino subtili. Quid generant: chimum mediocriter bonum. Conueniunt calidis, iuuenibus et pueris, hyeme et frigidis regionibus.

selection: Nux indie is the securely identified table owner. Nuces and Castanee remain prose comparators only: initial visual table identifications were not reliable enough and are withdrawn; no matched table rows claimed.
correction: After closer inspection, apparent Castanee is possibly Cefalones and apparent Nuces may be a different heading. No reading is repaired from prose.
